speaker: jesus
text: Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: apostles
text: Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?
name: The apostles

speaker: jesus
text: It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: angels
text: Men of Galilee,
name: Two men in white

speaker: angels
text: why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.
name: Two men in white

speaker: peter
text: Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.
name: Peter

speaker: apostles
text: Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
name: The apostles

speaker: apostles
text: to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.
name: The apostles

speaker: crowd
text: Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: What does this mean?
name: The crowd

speaker: mockers
text: They are drunk on new wine!
name: Some in the crowd

speaker: peter
text: Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!
name: Peter

speaker: crowd
text: Brothers, what shall we do?
name: The crowd

speaker: peter
text: Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Be saved from this corrupt generation.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Look at us!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Men of Israel, why are you surprised by this? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send Jesus, the Christ, who has been appointed for you.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.
name: Peter

speaker: sanhedrin
text: By what power or what name did you do this?
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: peter
text: Rulers and elders of the people!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.
name: Peter

speaker: sanhedrin
text: What shall we do with these men?
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: sanhedrin
text: It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: sanhedrin
text: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: peter-john
text: Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
name: Peter and John

speaker: peter-john
text: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.
name: Peter and John

speaker: believers
text: Sovereign Lord,
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
name: The believers

speaker: believers
text: as You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.
name: The believers

speaker: peter
text: Ananias, how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land?
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Tell me,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: is this the price you and your husband got for the land?
name: Peter

speaker: sapphira
text: Yes,
name: Sapphira

speaker: sapphira
text: that is the price.
name: Sapphira

speaker: peter
text: How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Look, the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.
name: Peter

speaker: angel
text: Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: officers
text: We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.
name: The officers

speaker: someone
text: Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!
name: Someone

speaker: high-priest
text: We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,
name: The high priest

speaker: high-priest
text: Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.
name: The high priest

speaker: apostles
text: We must obey God rather than men.
name: The apostles

speaker: apostles
text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.
name: The apostles

speaker: apostles
text: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
name: The apostles

speaker: apostles
text: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.
name: The apostles

speaker: gamaliel
text: Men of Israel,
name: Gamaliel

speaker: gamaliel
text: consider carefully what you are about to do to these men.
name: Gamaliel

speaker: gamaliel
text: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
name: Gamaliel

speaker: gamaliel
text: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.
name: Gamaliel

speaker: gamaliel
text: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
name: Gamaliel

speaker: gamaliel
text: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.
name: Gamaliel

speaker: twelve
text: It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
name: The Twelve

speaker: twelve
text: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will appoint this responsibility to them
name: The Twelve

speaker: twelve
text: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.
name: The Twelve

speaker: witnesses
text: We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.
name: The false witnesses

speaker: witnesses
text: This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
name: The false witnesses

speaker: witnesses
text: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.
name: The false witnesses

speaker: high-priest
text: Are these charges true?
name: The high priest

speaker: stephen
text: Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose over Egypt.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Has not My hand made all these things?’
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Look,
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
name: Stephen

speaker: stephen
text: Lord, do not hold this sin against them.
name: Stephen

speaker: samaritans
text: This man is the divine power called the Great Power.
name: The people of Samaria

speaker: simon
text: Give me this power as well,
name: Simon the sorcerer

speaker: simon
text: so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.
name: Simon the sorcerer

speaker: peter
text: May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.
name: Peter

speaker: simon
text: Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.
name: Simon the sorcerer

speaker: angel
text: Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: spirit
text: Go over to that chariot and stay by it.
name: The Holy Spirit

speaker: philip
text: Do you understand what you are reading?
name: Philip

speaker: eunuch
text: How can I,
name: The Ethiopian eunuch

speaker: eunuch
text: unless someone guides me?
name: The Ethiopian eunuch

speaker: eunuch
text: Tell me,
name: The Ethiopian eunuch

speaker: eunuch
text: who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?
name: The Ethiopian eunuch

speaker: eunuch
text: Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?
name: The Ethiopian eunuch

speaker: jesus
text: Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: saul
text: Who are You, Lord?
name: Saul

speaker: jesus
text: I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.
name: Jesus

speaker: lord
text: Ananias!
name: The Lord

speaker: ananias
text: Here I am, Lord,
name: Ananias

speaker: lord
text: Get up!
name: The Lord

speaker: lord
text: Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
name: The Lord

speaker: lord
text: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.
name: The Lord

speaker: ananias
text: Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
name: Ananias

speaker: ananias
text: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.
name: Ananias

speaker: lord
text: Go!
name: The Lord

speaker: lord
text: This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
name: The Lord

speaker: lord
text: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.
name: The Lord

speaker: ananias
text: Brother Saul,
name: Ananias

speaker: ananias
text: the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
name: Ananias

speaker: saul
text: He is the Son of God.
name: Saul

speaker: people
text: Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?
name: The people of Damascus

speaker: peter
text: Aeneas,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.
name: Peter

speaker: messengers
text: Come to us without delay.
name: The messengers from Joppa

speaker: peter
text: Tabitha, get up!
name: Peter

speaker: angel
text: Cornelius!
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: cornelius
text: What is it, Lord?
name: Cornelius

speaker: angel
text: Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: voice
text: Get up, Peter, kill and eat!
name: The voice from heaven

speaker: peter
text: No, Lord!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.
name: Peter

speaker: voice
text: Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.
name: The voice from heaven

speaker: spirit
text: Behold, three men are looking for you.
name: The Holy Spirit

speaker: spirit
text: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.
name: The Holy Spirit

speaker: peter
text: Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?
name: Peter

speaker: men
text: Cornelius the centurion has sent us,
name: Cornelius' men

speaker: men
text: He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.
name: Cornelius' men

speaker: peter
text: Stand up,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: I am only a man myself.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?
name: Peter

speaker: cornelius
text: Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
name: Cornelius

speaker: cornelius
text: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
name: Cornelius

speaker: cornelius
text: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
name: Cornelius

speaker: cornelius
text: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.
name: Cornelius

speaker: peter
text: I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!
name: Peter

speaker: circumcised
text: You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.
name: The circumcised believers

speaker: peter
text: I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, as He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?
name: Peter

speaker: church
text: So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.
name: The church in Jerusalem

speaker: angel
text: Get up quickly.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Get dressed and put on your sandals,
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: peter
text: Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.
name: Peter

speaker: rhoda
text: Peter is standing at the gate!
name: Rhoda

speaker: household
text: You are out of your mind,
name: Those in the house

speaker: household
text: It must be his angel.
name: Those in the house

speaker: peter
text: Send word to James and to the brothers,
name: Peter

speaker: tyre
text: This is the voice of a god, not a man!
name: The people

speaker: spirit
text: Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.
name: The Holy Spirit

speaker: paul
text: O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness, you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery! Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.
name: Paul

speaker: leaders
text: Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.
name: The synagogue leaders

speaker: paul
text: Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as an inheritance.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them forty years under Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Before the arrival of Jesus, John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not that One. But He is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But God raised Him from the dead,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And now we proclaim to you the good news: What God promised our fathers
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you:
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: paul
text: Stand up on your feet!
name: Paul

speaker: lycaonians
text: The gods have come down to us in human form!
name: The crowds of Lystra

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: In past generations, He let all nations go their own way.
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: paul-barnabas
text: We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,
name: Paul and Barnabas

speaker: judeans
text: Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.
name: Men from Judea

speaker: pharisees
text: The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses.
name: Believing Pharisees

speaker: peter
text: Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: He made no distinction between us and them, for He cleansed their hearts by faith.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Now then, why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear?
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: On the contrary, we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.
name: Peter

speaker: james
text: Brothers, listen to me!
name: James

speaker: james
text: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
name: James

speaker: james
text: The words of the prophets agree with this, as it is written:
name: James

speaker: james
text: ‘After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
name: James

speaker: james
text: so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord, and all the Gentiles who are called by My name, says the Lord who does these things
name: James

speaker: james
text: that have been known for ages.’
name: James

speaker: james
text: It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not cause trouble for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
name: James

speaker: james
text: Instead, we should write and tell them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals, and from blood.
name: James

speaker: james
text: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.
name: James

speaker: paul
text: Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.
name: Paul

speaker: macedonian
text: Come over to Macedonia and help us.
name: The man of Macedonia

speaker: lydia
text: If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.
name: Lydia

speaker: slave-girl
text: These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!
name: The slave girl

speaker: paul
text: In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!
name: Paul

speaker: owners
text: These men are Jews and are throwing our city into turmoil
name: The girl's owners

speaker: owners
text: by promoting customs that are unlawful for us Romans to adopt or practice.
name: The girl's owners

speaker: paul
text: Do not harm yourself! We are all here!
name: Paul

speaker: jailer
text: Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
name: The jailer

speaker: paul-silas
text: Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.
name: Paul and Silas

speaker: magistrates
text: Release those men.
name: The magistrates

speaker: jailer
text: The magistrates have sent orders to release you. Now you may go on your way in peace.
name: The jailer

speaker: paul
text: They beat us publicly without a trial and threw us into prison, even though we are Roman citizens. And now do they want to send us away secretly? Absolutely not! Let them come themselves and escort us out!
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Christ,
name: Paul

speaker: jews
text: These men who have turned the world upside down have now come here,
name: The Jews

speaker: jews
text: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, named Jesus!
name: The Jews

speaker: philosophers
text: What is this babbler trying to say?
name: The philosophers

speaker: philosophers
text: He seems to be advocating foreign gods.
name: The philosophers

speaker: athenians
text: May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
name: The Athenians

speaker: athenians
text: For you are bringing some strange notions to our ears, and we want to know what they mean.
name: The Athenians

speaker: paul
text: Men of Athens, I see that in every way you are very religious.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore what you worship as something unknown, I now proclaim to you.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: From one man He made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and He determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: God intended that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by man’s skill and imagination.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Although God overlooked the ignorance of earlier times, He now commands all people everywhere to repent.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.
name: Paul

speaker: athenians
text: We want to hear you again on this topic.
name: The Athenians

speaker: paul
text: Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.
name: Paul

speaker: lord
text: Do not be afraid; keep on speaking; do not be silent.
name: The Lord

speaker: lord
text: For I am with you and no one will lay a hand on you, because I have many people in this city.
name: The Lord

speaker: jews
text: This man is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law,
name: The Jews

speaker: gallio
text: If this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to hear your complaint.
name: Gallio

speaker: gallio
text: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.
name: Gallio

speaker: paul
text: I will come back to you if God is willing.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?
name: Paul

speaker: ephesians
text: No,
name: The disciples at Ephesus

speaker: ephesians
text: we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.
name: The disciples at Ephesus

speaker: paul
text: Into what, then, were you baptized?
name: Paul

speaker: ephesians
text: The baptism of John,
name: The disciples at Ephesus

speaker: paul
text: John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the One coming after him, that is, in Jesus.
name: Paul

speaker: exorcists
text: I bind you by Jesus, whom Paul proclaims.
name: The Jewish exorcists

speaker: evil-spirit
text: Jesus I know, and I know about Paul, but who are you?
name: The evil spirit

speaker: paul
text: After I have been there,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I must see Rome as well.
name: Paul

speaker: demetrius
text: Men,
name: Demetrius

speaker: demetrius
text: you know that this business is our source of prosperity.
name: Demetrius

speaker: demetrius
text: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.
name: Demetrius

speaker: demetrius
text: There is danger not only that our business will fall into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited and her majesty deposed—she who is worshiped by all the province of Asia and the whole world.
name: Demetrius

speaker: crowd
text: Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!
name: The crowd

speaker: clerk
text: Men of Ephesus, doesn’t everyone know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
name: The city clerk

speaker: clerk
text: Since these things are undeniable, you ought to be calm and not do anything rash.
name: The city clerk

speaker: clerk
text: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
name: The city clerk

speaker: clerk
text: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open and proconsuls are available. Let them bring charges against one another there.
name: The city clerk

speaker: clerk
text: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
name: The city clerk

speaker: clerk
text: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.
name: The city clerk

speaker: paul
text: Do not be alarmed!
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: He is still alive!
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears, especially in the trials that came upon me through the plots of the Jews.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I did not shrink back from declaring anything that was helpful to you as I taught you publicly and from house to house,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: testifying to Jews and Greeks alike about repentance to God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Now I know that none of you among whom I have preached the kingdom will see my face again.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For I did not shrink back from declaring to you the whole will of God.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Keep watch over yourselves and the entire flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which He purchased with His own blood.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I know that after my departure, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Even from your own number, men will rise up and distort the truth to draw away disciples after them.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Therefore be alert and remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And now I commit you to God and to the word of His grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have ministered to my own needs and those of my companions.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’
name: Paul

speaker: agabus
text: The Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’
name: Agabus

speaker: paul
text: Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
name: Paul

speaker: companions
text: The Lord’s will be done.
name: Paul's companions

speaker: elders
text: You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
name: James and the elders

speaker: elders
text: But they are under the impression that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or observe our customs.
name: James and the elders

speaker: elders
text: What then should we do? They will certainly hear that you have come.
name: James and the elders

speaker: elders
text: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
name: James and the elders

speaker: elders
text: Take these men, purify yourself along with them, and pay their expenses so they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know that there is no truth to these rumors about you, but that you also live in obedience to the law.
name: James and the elders

speaker: elders
text: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality.
name: James and the elders

speaker: asian-jews
text: Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches everywhere against our people and against our law and against this place. Furthermore, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.
name: The Jews from Asia

speaker: crowd
text: Away with him!
name: The crowd

speaker: paul
text: May I say something to you?
name: Paul

speaker: commander
text: Do you speak Greek?
name: The commander

speaker: commander
text: Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the ‘Assassins’ into the wilderness?
name: The commander

speaker: paul
text: I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Now I beg you to allow me to speak to the people.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I am just as zealous for God as any of you here today.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: as the high priest and the whole Council can testify about me. I even obtained letters from them to their brothers in Damascus, and I was on my way to apprehend these people and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: About noon as I was approaching Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ He replied.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: My companions saw the light, but they could not understand the voice of the One speaking to me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: There a man named Ananias, a devout observer of the law who was highly regarded by all the Jews living there,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: came and stood beside me. ‘Brother Saul,’ he said, ‘receive your sight.’ And at that moment I could see him.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Then he said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear His voice.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: You will be His witness to everyone of what you have seen and heard.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized, and wash your sins away, calling on His name.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Later, when I had returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: and saw the Lord saying to me, ‘Hurry! Leave Jerusalem quickly, because the people here will not accept your testimony about Me.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘Lord,’ I answered, ‘they know very well that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in You.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Then He said to me, ‘Go! I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’
name: Paul

speaker: crowd
text: Rid the earth of him! He is not fit to live!
name: The crowd

speaker: paul
text: Is it lawful for you to flog a Roman citizen without a trial?
name: Paul

speaker: centurion
text: What are you going to do?
name: The centurion

speaker: centurion
text: This man is a Roman citizen.
name: The centurion

speaker: commander
text: Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?
name: The commander

speaker: paul
text: Yes,
name: Paul

speaker: commander
text: I paid a high price for my citizenship,
name: The commander

speaker: paul
text: But I was born a citizen,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.
name: Paul

speaker: bystanders
text: How dare you insult the high priest of God!
name: Those standing nearby

speaker: paul
text: Brothers,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I was not aware that he was the high priest, for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.
name: Paul

speaker: scribes
text: We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?
name: The scribes

speaker: lord
text: Take courage! As you have testified about Me in Jerusalem, so also you must testify in Rome.
name: The Lord

speaker: conspirators
text: We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.
name: The conspirators

speaker: conspirators
text: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.
name: The conspirators

speaker: paul
text: Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.
name: Paul

speaker: centurion
text: Paul the prisoner sent and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.
name: The centurion

speaker: commander
text: What do you need to tell me?
name: The commander

speaker: nephew
text: The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul to the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of acquiring more information about him.
name: Paul's nephew

speaker: nephew
text: Do not let them persuade you, because more than forty men are waiting to ambush him. They have bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him; they are ready now, awaiting your consent.
name: Paul's nephew

speaker: commander
text: Do not tell anyone that you have reported this to me.
name: The commander

speaker: commander
text: Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea in the third hour of the night.
name: The commander

speaker: commander
text: Provide mounts for Paul to take him safely to Governor Felix.
name: The commander

speaker: felix
text: I will hear your case when your accusers arrive.
name: Felix

speaker: tertullus
text: Because of you, we have enjoyed a lasting peace, and your foresight has brought improvements to this nation.
name: Tertullus

speaker: tertullus
text: In every way and everywhere, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with all gratitude.
name: Tertullus

speaker: tertullus
text: But in order not to burden you any further, I beg your indulgence to hear us briefly.
name: Tertullus

speaker: tertullus
text: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
name: Tertullus

speaker: tertullus
text: and he even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
name: Tertullus

speaker: tertullus
text: By examining him yourself, you will be able to learn the truth about all our charges against him.
name: Tertullus

speaker: paul
text: Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, I gladly make my defense.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: You can verify for yourself that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Yet my accusers did not find me debating with anyone in the temple or riling up a crowd in the synagogues or in the city.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Nor can they prove to you any of their charges against me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I do confess to you, however, that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: At the time they found me in the temple, I was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar. But there are some Jews from the province of Asia
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Otherwise, let these men state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: unless it was this one thing I called out as I stood in their presence: ‘It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.’
name: Paul

speaker: felix
text: When Lysias the commander comes, I will decide your case.
name: Felix

speaker: felix
text: You may go for now. When I find the time, I will call for you.
name: Felix

speaker: festus
text: Paul is being held in Caesarea, and I myself am going there soon.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.
name: Festus

speaker: paul
text: I have committed no offense against the law of the Jews or against the temple or against Caesar.
name: Paul

speaker: festus
text: Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?
name: Festus

speaker: paul
text: I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!
name: Paul

speaker: festus
text: You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go!
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: There is a certain man whom Felix left in prison.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: While I was in Jerusalem, the chief priests and elders of the Jews presented their case and requested a judgment against him.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand a man over before he has had an opportunity to face his accusers and defend himself against their charges.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: So when they came here with me, I did not delay. The next day I sat on the judgment seat and ordered that the man be brought in.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: But when his accusers rose to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: They only had some contentions with him regarding their own religion and a certain Jesus who had died, but whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: Since I was at a loss as to how to investigate these matters, I asked if he was willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried there on these charges.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: But when Paul appealed to be held over for the decision of the Emperor, I ordered that he be held until I could send him to Caesar.
name: Festus

speaker: agrippa
text: I would like to hear this man myself.
name: Agrippa

speaker: festus
text: Tomorrow you will hear him,
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: King Agrippa and all who are present with us, you see this man. The whole Jewish community has petitioned me about him, both here and in Jerusalem, crying out that he ought not to live any longer.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: But I found he had done nothing worthy of death, and since he has now appealed to the Emperor, I decided to send him.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: I have nothing definite to write to our sovereign one about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this inquiry I may have something to write.
name: Festus

speaker: festus
text: For it seems unreasonable to me to send on a prisoner without specifying the charges against him.
name: Festus

speaker: agrippa
text: You have permission to speak for yourself.
name: Agrippa

speaker: paul
text: King Agrippa, I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today to defend myself against all the accusations of the Jews,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: especially since you are acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. I beg you, therefore, to listen to me patiently.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Surely all the Jews know how I have lived from the earliest days of my youth, among my own people and in Jerusalem.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And now I stand on trial because of my hope in the promise that God made to our fathers,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: the promise our twelve tribes are hoping to realize as they earnestly serve God day and night. It is because of this hope, O king, that I am accused by the Jews.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Why would any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So then, I too was convinced that I ought to do all I could to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: And that is what I did in Jerusalem. With authority from the chief priests I put many of the saints in prison, and when they were condemned to death, I cast my vote against them.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I frequently had them punished in the synagogues, and I tried to make them blaspheme. In my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: In this pursuit I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: About noon, O king, as I was on the road, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and my companions.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘But get up and stand on your feet. For I have appeared to you to appoint you as a servant and as a witness of what you have seen from Me and what I will show you.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I will rescue you from your own people and from the Gentiles. I am sending you to them
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So then, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, then to everyone in the region of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I declared that they should repent and turn to God, performing deeds worthy of their repentance.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple courts and tried to kill me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But I have had God’s help to this day, and I stand here to testify to small and great alike. I am saying nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen:
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: that the Christ would suffer, and as the first to rise from the dead, would proclaim light to our people and to the Gentiles.
name: Paul

speaker: festus
text: You are insane, Paul! Your great learning is driving you to madness!
name: Festus

speaker: paul
text: I am not insane, most excellent Festus; I am speaking words of truth and sobriety.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For the king knows about these matters, and I can speak freely to him. I am confident that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.
name: Paul

speaker: agrippa
text: Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?
name: Agrippa

speaker: paul
text: Short time or long,
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: I wish to God that not only you but all who hear me this day may become what I am, except for these chains.
name: Paul

speaker: officials
text: This man has done nothing worthy of death or imprisonment.
name: Agrippa's company

speaker: agrippa
text: This man could have been released if he had not appealed to Caesar.
name: Agrippa

speaker: paul
text: Men, I can see that our voyage will be filled with disaster and great loss, not only to ship and cargo, but to our own lives as well.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Men, you should have followed my advice not to sail from Crete. Then you would have averted this disaster and loss.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because you will not experience any loss of life, but only of the ship.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For just last night an angel of God, whose I am and whom I serve, stood beside me
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul; you must stand before Caesar. And look, God has granted you the lives of all who sail with you.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: However, we must run aground on some island.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Unless these men remain with the ship, you cannot be saved.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Today is your fourteenth day in constant suspense, without taking any food.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So for your own preservation, I urge you to eat something, because not a single hair of your head will be lost.
name: Paul

speaker: islanders
text: Surely this man is a murderer. Although he was saved from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live.
name: The islanders

speaker: paul
text: Brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or the customs of our fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: They examined me and wanted to release me, because there was no basis for a death sentence against me.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar, even though I have no charge to bring against my nation.
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: So for this reason I have called to see you and speak with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.
name: Paul

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: We have not received any letters about you from Judea, nor have any of the brothers from there reported or even mentioned anything bad about you.
name: The leaders of the Jews in Rome

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: But we consider your views worth hearing, because we know that people everywhere are speaking against this sect.
name: The leaders of the Jews in Rome

speaker: paul
text: The Holy Spirit was right when He spoke to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet:
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: ‘Go to this people and say, “You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.”
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
name: Paul

speaker: paul
text: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!
name: Paul
